description: Frozen reference mapping used to convert DNC and FIP continuous action indices to R_D in {1,2,3,4,5}. New models are assigned to the nearest frozen center without refitting.

DNC.raw_measure: SI = logit(VCR / (VCR + HPR + 0.001)), clipped to [0.001, 0.999], computed on steps with drift_row != 0 (all steps if none)
DNC.direction: higher SI is more cautious; R_D=1 is most cautious

FIP.direction: higher high-risk allocation is more aggressive; R_D=1 is most cautious

CTD.direction: native five-level ordinal decision; used directly
